controls: Use only approved enterprise AI tools with enterprise data protection for processing internal information; internal data must not be used with public/consumer AI services (Data Classification and Handling Guide, Using classified information with AI tools).

All AI-generated press release drafts must be reviewed, edited and approved by a communications officer before any publication; AI output is never treated as a final product (Aurora Institute AI Use Policy, Principles).
The tool must not fabricate quotations, sources, data, or impersonate real people when drafting press releases (Aurora Institute AI Use Policy, Prohibited uses).

Since this is a limited-risk use case (external-facing content generated from internal information, not affecting individuals or restricted data), approval requires sign-off from both the Communications business owner and the Information Security team (AI Use Case Intake Procedure, Risk levels and approval).

An intake form must be submitted to the AI Office before building/deploying this assistant, as it goes beyond personal productivity use of approved tools (AI Use Case Intake Procedure, When to submit a use case).
